root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: after `op2 = append_shorthand_operation(options, OP__ADD_SEEKPOINT)`, `op` must be refreshed so it equals `find_shorthand_operation(options, OP__IMPORT_CUESHEET_FROM)` before the next line dereferences it.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the auto-seekpoint append in `parse_options()`, the `op` pointer consumed by the next line must still name the live `OP__IMPORT_CUESHEET_FROM` entry in `options->ops.operations` after the append returns.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original keeps the pre-append alias in `op` even when the append grows `options->ops.operations`; the fixed original reaches the same protected store with `op` rebound to the live import entry.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace records `seekpoint_append.op_ptr_after_append != seekpoint_append.current_import_op_ptr` and still reaches `link_store_sink`; the fixed trace records equality at the same protected store.

nodes.state: At `op->argument.import_cuesheet_from.add_seekpoint_link = ...`, the sink writes through `op` even though `op` no longer equals the live `OP__IMPORT_CUESHEET_FROM` entry in the current operations array.

Across the selected `append_shorthand_operation()` call, `options->ops.operations` changes base address on the crash path, so the caller-held `op` alias from the old buffer becomes stale before the next line.

edges.relation: The caller-held pre-append `op` alias survives unchanged to the next line and becomes the `op` pointer through which `add_seekpoint_link` is stored at the sink.
